sonnet.problem: The statement tests two claims at once: that Nicodemus asks whether the law convicts a man without hearing him, and that the others answer by asking if he is from Galilee too. Its first half also re-asks the fact card 7 just answered.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.

sonnet.problem: The opening card says people have tried to seize Jesus but no one laid a hand on Him. This gives away the answer to the later true/false card 11, which asks whether someone lays a hand on Him when some in the crowd want to seize Him.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
